scope: Rust owns the remaining aggregate preconnect claim count in the authoritative request queue. Add a claim when creating a preconnect before native assignment, consume once for a real request, cap after native removal, reset before native drop. Returning a job does not mint a claim.
implementation: Seven paths. No extra FFI crossing for increment; integrated into the existing release recipient selection. Claim, cap/reset and diagnostic count use private scalar ABI methods.
validation: Local candidate and source check only, unpublished. Pool runtime regression is running on the separate exact f2e45f1e head.
